signals.usability_note: Shows the side of a house with a yellow-sided gable, mostly screened by a row of arborvitae and a white picket fence. The view of the house is partial but sufficient for a rough assessment.

signals.notes: Corner-lot side view with the house mostly hidden behind a tall arborvitae hedge and white fence; the front entrance and roof surface are not visible, so a rep may want a closer look.
